omitted_artifact_policy: Explicit sources only. Sensitive, recursive handoff/ZIP, missing, oversized, and duplicate files are omitted with a reason and canonical reference. Unrelated repository/artifact trees are not discovered.
sensitive_file_policy: Reject .env variants, credential/API-key/token/secret/private-key/auth-cache filename patterns, key/certificate suffixes, VCS, virtualenv, dependency, and cache paths without inspecting secret values.
